title: UDP ClientHello parsers must be gated by heuristic checks
answers: What is the requirement when adding UDP protocol detection to next_layer?
How should UDP ClientHello sniffing in _get_client_hello handle unknown or empty packets?
Where is UDP protocol discrimination enforced in next_layer?
body:
Protocol ClientHello parsers for UDP connections must be gated by framing heuristic checks (_starts_like_quic, starts_like_dtls_record) before parsing.
Enforced in mitmproxy/addons/next_layer.py:_get_client_hello.
If skipped, non-matching or empty stream data falls into parsers that raise NeedsMoreData on partial structures, stalling layer negotiation indefinitely.
says: UDP connections freeze indefinitely during handshake when unknown traffic reaches the proxy.
Non standard UDP packets cause incoming streams to stall without passing through.
The proxy hangs when inspecting unrecognized UDP streams instead of forwarding them.
Ensure unusual UDP datagrams do not block connection negotiation or pause proxy traffic.
